title: Main board - U17 = onsemi NCP59800 LDO and its pins (raptox's unit, mosaic 2026-11-03)
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03; pin connections from the NCP59800 datasheet

callouts.label: onsemi NCP59800 adjustable 1 A low-noise LDO: makes the logic rail
callouts.part: NCP59800, adjustable version (ADJB), DFN8 3 x 3 mm, 0.65 mm pitch, exposed pad to GND
callouts.note: The marking matches onsemi's marking diagram line by line (NCP59800/D Rev. 3 p1: 59800 / ADJB / ALYW plus the microdot; GAJL is the assembly, lot, year and week code), on the DFN8 3 x 3 mm at 0.65 mm (measured 0.653 mm). A quarter turn counter-clockwise from the datasheet's top view: pin 1 bottom left (the dot), OUT 1-2, FB 3, GND 4 along the bottom, EN 5, NR 6, IN 7-8 right to left along the top. Output about 3.3 V (likely; the divider is not measured). J-271.

callouts.label: Pin-1 mark (laser dot)
callouts.note: onsemi's pin-1 circle (p1). The second dot, after GAJL, is the Pb-free microdot.

callouts.label: U17 pin 1, OUT
callouts.note: Regulator output: the logic rail. Never above VIN + 0.3 V: never feed the rail with the input unpowered (p2, J-110). Position from the pin-1 mark and the datasheet's pin connections (p1, p2).

callouts.label: U17 pin 2, OUT
callouts.note: Regulator output, with pin 1. Position from the pin-1 mark and the datasheet's pin connections (p1, p2).

callouts.label: U17 pin 3, FB
callouts.note: Feedback: the divider R589/R590 sets VOUT = 0.8 V x (1 + R1/R2) (p9). Position from the pin-1 mark and the datasheet's pin connections (p1, p2).

callouts.label: U17 pin 4, GND
callouts.note: Ground, with the exposed pad. Position from the pin-1 mark and the datasheet's pin connections (p1, p2).

callouts.label: U17 pin 5, EN
callouts.note: Enable, high = on. Position from the pin-1 mark and the datasheet's pin connections (p1, p2).

callouts.label: U17 pin 6, NR
callouts.note: Noise reduction: its small cap C604 (nets.md). Position from the pin-1 mark and the datasheet's pin connections (p1, p2).

callouts.label: U17 pin 7, IN
callouts.note: Input, 2.2-6.0 V (absolute maximum 6.5 V, p2): J8 pins 1-6 / JP5.1 (J-080). Position from the pin-1 mark and the datasheet's pin connections (p1, p2).

callouts.label: U17 pin 8, IN
callouts.note: Input, with pin 7. Position from the pin-1 mark and the datasheet's pin connections (p1, p2).
